title: Hold out adjacent and unauthorized files explicitly
applies_when: the task requires deciding between allowed_targets and held_targets
the model risks broadening scope beyond packet authority
the model may return empty schema-shaped JSON instead of a scoped decision
correction_instruction: Put only explicitly allowed files into allowed_targets.
Move plausible unauthorized or adjacent files into held_targets.
If a target/holdout decision is required, do not return empty schema-shaped JSON.
Do not claim all files or docs are in scope unless the packet explicitly authorizes that scope.
validator_expectations: allowed_targets must contain only packet-authorized files
held_targets should contain plausible unauthorized or adjacent files when required
scope_expansion_required should be true when requested targets exceed allowed_files
known_failure_modes: allowed_targets is empty when a scoped decision is required
held_targets is empty when plausible unauthorized files are present
empty schema-shaped JSON is returned instead of a scoped decision
all files/docs are claimed to be in scope without packet authority
provenance_notes: Derived from repeated file-scope authorization correction failures observed in supervised local LARQL work.
This is evidence-backed scaffold guidance, not a model-weight update.
non_authorities: does not authorize training data capture
